mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting (project_id, title, meet_date, summary, content) VALUES (#{project_id}, #{title}, #{meet_date}, #{summary}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM meeting WHERE project_id = #{project_id} ORDER BY meet_date DESC

SELECT m.* FROM meeting m JOIN project p ON m.project_id = p.project_id JOIN participation pa ON p.project_id = pa.project_id WHERE pa.member_id = #{member_id} AND pa.join_status = 'JOINED' AND m.meet_date BETWEEN NOW() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY m.meet_date ASC
